name: Kevlar vest
text: Toughness 1 against guns and blades. Doesn't stack with other Toughness.

name: Tactical armor
text: Toughness 1 against everything, but Disadvantage on Vanish and climbing.

name: Powered armor
text: Toughness 2 against blunt, blades and guns. Unreliable: when you roll a Miss while wearing it, the GM can cut it out (out of power, a jammed joint, a short circuit, whatever fits the scene). While it is offline it gives no Toughness. Spend a Quick Action to get it running again, or it is repaired at Dawn. Doesn't stack with other Toughness.

name: Sidearm
text: A gun (Flow to shoot). Far range is at Disadvantage.

name: Long gun
text: A gun with no Far penalty. Being seen carrying one is +1 Heat.

name: Baton
text: Light melee: +1 Harm on a Strike at Impact 2 or better. Jabs with it have no -2 penalty.

name: Fighting sticks
text: Light melee: +1 Harm on a Strike at Impact 2 or better. Jabs with it have no -2 penalty.

name: Weighted gloves
text: Light melee: +1 Harm on a Strike at Impact 2 or better. Jabs with it have no -2 penalty.

name: Bat
text: Heavy melee: +1 Harm on any hit, but only on a Strike (never a Jab).

name: Pipe
text: Heavy melee: +1 Harm on any hit, but only on a Strike (never a Jab).

name: Crowbar
text: Heavy melee: +1 Harm on any hit, but only on a Strike (never a Jab).

name: Knife
text: Everyone has one. +1 Harm on Impact 2 or better against anyone without Toughness. Can be thrown at Near range. A backup: an attack uses one weapon, never two weapon bonuses.

name: Grapple line
text: Quick Action: move to any zone you can see, including High Ground.

name: Med kit
text: Once per fight, Full Action: an ally next to you clears one Harm box (Down becomes Wounded).

name: Night-vision goggles
text: Dark zones don't affect you.

name: Police scanner
text: Once per Night, Edge on a Patrol roll. You also hear the cops coming a round early.

name: Earpiece comms
text: You can Help allies in any zone.

name: Taser
text: A Jab. On a hit, the target loses their next Quick Action (a named enemy has Disadvantage on their next roll instead: see Named enemies resist being shut down). Electricity, so it ignores Toughness. Two uses per fight.

name: Tracker
text: Tag someone. If they get away, take 1 clue about where they went.

name: Pepper spray
text: Quick Action, Engaged. On a hit, the target has Disadvantage on attacks until the end of their next turn.

name: Smoke grenades
text: Quick Action: a zone becomes Dark until the end of next round. Two per fight.

name: Flashbangs
text: Quick Action: roll Flow against the Guard of everyone in a zone; everyone you beat has Disadvantage on their next roll. One per fight. Named enemies: see Named enemies resist being shut down.

name: Bolas or net launcher
text: Ranged, Near. On a hit, the target can't take their free move until they spend a Quick Action to get free.

name: Riot shield
text: +1 Guard. Take Cover works anywhere. Disadvantage on Vanish, and you can't use a long gun.

name: Mask and voice changer
text: Edge on rolls to scare or bluff someone who doesn't know you.

name: Lockpicks and bypass kit
text: Edge on getting through locked doors, alarms and safes.

name: Burner phones
text: Once per Night, use a contact-based ability (Plugs, Network, or calling in a contact with Drive) one extra time. Any clue it gives still counts toward your one no-roll clue per Night.

name: Bike or car
text: One extra Patrol action per Night. In a chase, Edge on Flow.

name: Drone
text: Quick Action: see into any zone within Far range. The spot lasts until the start of your next turn. Allies attacking a target you've spotted get Edge, once per round. Breaks on any hit.

name: Climbing gear and gloves
text: Hard climbs to High Ground need no roll. No Hazard cost for falls of one story.

name: Bow
text: A bow or crossbow (Flow to shoot). No Far penalty, and +1 Harm on Impact 2 or better. Silent: unlike a gun, it adds no Heat on its own. Not a gun, so Toughness applies. Like a gun, it is at Disadvantage when you're engaged in melee.

name: Stun grenade
text: Quick Action, Near zone. Everyone there without ear and eye protection rolls Focus vs 12 or loses their next turn; mooks just lose it. Allies in the zone are caught too. Named enemies: see Named enemies resist being shut down. One per fight.

name: Taser gun
text: Near range. On a hit, instead of Harm, the target loses their next Quick Action (a named enemy has Disadvantage on their next roll instead: see Named enemies resist being shut down) and a mook drops. Electricity, so it ignores Toughness. Two shots per fight, and reloading between them takes a Quick Action.

name: Tossies
text: Ranged, Near. Flow to throw. A hit deals 1 Harm (Toughness applies). On Impact 2 or better the target drops what they're holding, so their weapon bonus is off until they spend a Quick Action to recover it. If they hold nothing, they lose their next Quick Action instead (a named enemy has Disadvantage on their next roll: see Named enemies resist being shut down). Three per fight.

name: Forensic kit
text: Once per case, spend a scene working a crime scene or an object and take 1 clue, no roll.

name: Hacking rig
text: Edge on Focus rolls against systems, cameras and records. Once per Night, take 1 clue from them with no roll. If it comes from police or city records, take +1 Heat.

name: Weighted lash
text: A light melee weapon on a cable: +1 Harm on a Strike at Impact 2 or better, and Jabs with it have no -2 penalty. Quick Action, Near range: pull an enemy to Engaged with you, or swing yourself to High Ground in your zone or the next one.

name: Trip mines
text: Quick Action: set a trap in your zone. The next enemy to move into it takes Impact 2, ignoring Toughness, and stops there. Two per fight.

name: Scoped rifle
text: A long gun with a scope. Edge on attacks at Far range if you haven't moved this turn. Being seen carrying one is +1 Heat.

name: Rebreather
text: Gas and fumes don't affect you, and you ignore stun grenades and flashbangs (built-in ear and eye protection).

name: Caltrops
text: Quick Action: scatter them in a zone you're leaving. Until the end of next round, any enemy who moves in stops there. In a chase, anyone behind you has Disadvantage on Flow rolls. Two per fight.

name: Tranquilizer darts
text: Ranged, Near. On a hit, a mook goes down. A named enemy has Disadvantage on all rolls until the end of their next turn, and a second hit in the same fight costs them one turn (see Named enemies resist being shut down). Two per fight.

name: Restraints
text: Full Action: bind an enemy who is Down, surrendering or willing. They can't act until freed or the scene ends. A bound prisoner can be interrogated.

name: Disguise kit
text: Take on a new identity for a scene. Once per Night, pass as someone else with no roll. If you're seen through, take +1 Heat.

name: Glider cape
text: Falls of any height cost you nothing, and you can drop into any zone below you as a free move.
